_comment: Corrections and reviews of the Charity Commission register's Part B figures for the colleges (stage college_finances, source-research §22). One entry per (charityNumber, periodEnd). An entry with values replaces those fields (status `override`); an entry with `review` keeps the row out of the figures (status `needs_review`) for that reason; an entry with neither accepts the register's row as filed after a human read the accounts (status `register`, its checks kept, the citation recorded). Every entry cites the accounts PDF, the page and why. A correcting or accepting entry pins `registerFiled`, the register's figure(s) the reviewer read: if the college re-files and the register then says otherwise, the entry no longer applies and the row is posted needs_review (`override_stale:<field>`). `standing` lists colleges whose register figure differs in definition from the page's every year: each of their periods without its own entry is held back (needs_review) until an entry for it is added from that year's accounts.
